description: This file defines a custom JUnit test rule that grants the POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission on Android devices running SDK version TIRAMISU or higher.

classes.name: GrantPostNotificationsPermissionRule
classes.description: A custom test rule that grants POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission if the device SDK version is TIRAMISU or higher.

methods.name: GrantPostNotificationsPermissionRule
methods.description: Constructor that implements the TestRule interface by granting POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission when SDK version >= TIRAMISU, otherwise grants with no specific permission.
